text.p: Paneuropean Insurance Company on Wednesday announced a reshuffle of its life and general insurance portfolios to Philiki Insurance and Interamerican Insurance Company.

Under terms of the reshuffle, announced at a news conference by Nicos Shakolas, chairman of all three companies, life insurance portfolios of Paneuropean and Philiki will be transferred to Interamerican Insurance.
The general insurance portfolio of Interamerican and Paneuropean will be transferred to Philiki Insurance, while Paneuropean will be the holding company.
Shakolas said the move was cost saving for the group, which has already reduced its workforce by 17 percent to 288 people.
Interamerican, said Shakolas, has 31 percent of the Cyprus market in life insurance policies and will have an estimated 67,500 clients by the end of the year, up from 62,503 in 1995.
Life insurance policies are tax deductable in Cyprus.

"A conservative estimate for 1996 makes us feel certain that we will exceed a turnover of five million pounds ($10.8 million) something which will undoubtedly place us first in the Cypriot market," he said.
Philiki controls about 18 percent of the local market.
